# Plan: pin workspace to machine default on activation

## Requirements (user-approved)
Every NEW workspace row and every un-exit (restore, unarchive, unsnooze manual+timed, uncomplete incl. kanban) pins to the tray default at that moment via a normal pin. Only the explicit adopt procedure stays Following. No default known -> Following (forcing Following if a stale pin exists) + warn. Never fail create/restore. No UI, no schema. Unmanaged hosts and cloud-sandbox workspaces: no-op.

## Recommended approach
Pin-by-default inside `insertLocalWorkspace`, opt-OUT only for explicit adopt. Smaller than v1's opt-in: one `false` at two call sites instead of `true` at six (`registerLocalWorkspace` `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspaces/workspaces.ts:541`, `workspace-creation/procedures/create-session.ts:146`, `project/utils/ensure-main-workspace.ts:138`, `workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts:109,183` reached from `workspaces.ts:758/:1032/:1097`). Safer: a future create path cannot forget the flag. Host helper `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id, {onlyIfFollowing?})` never throws; delegates to `setWorkspaceAccount` (`packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/index.ts:368`). Restore paths call a new tRPC procedure from the renderer (exit state lives only in `v2WorkspaceLocalState`).

Rejected: pin in `mintProfileForNewWorkspace` (`index.ts:312`, adopt calls it); pin in `ensureProfileForLaunch` (every launch); host-side restore detection (no exit state on host).

## Files
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/index.ts`: interface `:89` + impl. `if (!this.managed) return`. `identity = await profiles.readGlobalIdentity()` (catch -> warn). Read row slug. Cases: (a) `identity.kind==="tray"`: if `onlyIfFollowing && row.slug!==null` skip; else `setWorkspaceAccount(id, identity.slug)`. (b) not tray: if `row.slug!==null && !onlyIfFollowing` -> `setWorkspaceAccount(id, null)` (force Following); else warn "no machine default". Whole body in try/catch -> `log.warn` with `{workspaceId, slug, error}`; `applyWorkspaceAccountTransition` (`:1585`) can throw mid credential write / DB update, so the catch must wrap the transition too. Call OUTSIDE locks: `setWorkspaceAccount` takes `withWorkspaceLock` (`:377`). Marker comment here.
- `packages/host-service/src/workspaces/local-workspace-store.ts`: `InsertWorkspaceStoreContext.claudeAccounts` (`:52`) gains the helper; `InsertLocalWorkspaceValues` (`:237`) gains `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` (default true). In `insertLocalWorkspace` AFTER `emitWorkspaceChanged` + `trackWorkspaceEvent` (`:304-305`): `if (values.pinClaudeAccountToDefault !== false) await ctx.claudeAccounts.pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id)`; then `getLocalWorkspace` re-read (`:296` pattern) and return that row. Broadcast is not delayed by Pi timeouts; the mutation return is (bounded by Pi client timeouts). Marker comment here.
- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts`: new arg `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` forwarded to both inserts (`:109`, `:183`). `workspace-creation/procedures/adopt.ts:81` and `workspaces.ts:910` (the `input.worktreePath` branch, `:893`) pass `false`. All other callers unchanged -> pin.
- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/claude-accounts/claude-accounts.ts`: `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: protectedProcedure.input(workspaceInput.extend({onlyIfFollowing: z.boolean().optional()})).mutation(...)`, no PRECONDITION wrap (`:21-45` pattern not needed; helper cannot throw).
- `packages/host-service/test/helpers/claude-accounts-fixture.ts:53`: add fake `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: async () => {}`.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/hooks/host-service/useClaudeAccounts/useClaudeAccounts.ts`: plain async `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(hostUrl, workspaceId, opts)` via `getHostServiceClientByUrl` (`:93`); on success invalidate account-state caches (`:98`).
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/retireWorkspaceRuntime.ts:37`: return `{verdict, ownerReleasedAccount}` where `ownerReleasedAccount = owner reply kind==="answered" && outcome.foundWorkspace && outcome.accountReleased`. Update `useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:198,216` destructuring.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/cleanupDecisions.ts`: pure `shouldPinAfterSettle({outcome, stampAfter, verdict, ownerReleasedAccount, bucket})` -> true iff `bucket==="active"` AND (`outcome==="clear"` OR (`outcome==="abandon" && stampAfter===null && verdict==="confirmed" && ownerReleasedAccount`)). Never on `unreachable`, never on absence (absence gives `ownerReleasedAccount=false`).
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/components/WorkspaceExitCleanupReconciler/useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:217-225`: after outcome, if `shouldPinAfterSettle` -> pin to `target.ownerHostUrl` with `onlyIfFollowing:true`, skipping when `target.isSandbox` (`:114`). Bucket via `getWorkspaceSidebarBucket` (`apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/providers/CollectionsProvider/dashboardSidebarLocal/sidebarVisibility.ts:178`). `onlyIfFollowing` is what protects a manual pin made after restore. Marker comment here.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/hooks/useDashboardSidebarState/useDashboardSidebarState.ts`: standalone `uncompleteWorkspaceInSidebar` (`:537`) gains a required `pinTarget: {workspaces, cache}` param and fires the pin after the update; both callers (`:1711`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/kanban/hooks/useKanbanData/useKanbanData.ts:500`, which already calls `useHostWorkspaces` at `:144` and must also destructure `cache`) pass it. `unsnoozeWorkspace` (`:1525`), `unarchiveWorkspaces` (`:1561`), `restoreWorkspace` (`:1671`), `autoReturnSnoozedWorkspace` (`:1515`): after the update, if `runtimeCleanupPendingAt` is null -> fire pin; else do nothing (auto-return keeps debt, `sidebarMutations.ts:126`; reconciler pins on settle: accepted deviation from "at that moment"). Deps of these callbacks are `[collections]` today; add `hostWorkspaces, hostWorkspacesCache` (`:552-553`). Owner URL: `hostWorkspaces` row `hostId` -> `cache.resolveHostUrl`; hard skip when `cache.isSandboxHost(hostId)` (approved; stricter than `resolveRetirementCallUrl`, no VM wake, no wasted call on an unmanaged host). Marker comment here.

## Sequence
Create: insert -> mint (Following creds) -> `created` broadcast -> pin (lock: roster/grace/token -> creds write + unconditional DB set `index.ts:477`, cause manual) -> re-read -> return.
Restore: renderer clears flags/cancels stamp -> pin RPC to owner -> same path. Retire and pin serialize on `withWorkspaceLock` (`:507`); ordering safety comes ONLY from the lock (DB write is `{kind:"set"}`, `:1600`, not compare-and-set). Pin-then-late-retire (owner reports `accountReleased:true`) is repaired by the settle-pin.
Pi grace (`:382-439`): three outcomes: pinned+token; pinned with `credentialAction:"keep"` and switch queued until Pi recovers (existing manual-pin semantics, `refreshPinned :965` finishes it); throw past grace -> warn, Following.

## Build order
1. Host helper + interface + fixture; unit tests. 2. Store default-pin + adopt opt-out (2 sites) + re-read; store/ensure-main tests. 3. Router procedure. 4. `retireWorkspaceRuntime` return shape + `shouldPinAfterSettle` + reconciler. 5. Renderer pin fn + un-exit callbacks + uncomplete param (both callers). 6. FEATURES.md / AGENTS.md / CONTEXT.md.

## Tests
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/service-regressions.test.ts` (describe `:191`): tray -> slug=default, `cause:"manual"`; absent identity + Following -> null + warn; absent identity + stale pin -> `setWorkspaceAccount(id,null)` called, row Following; Pi down within grace with last-good roster -> pinned, `credentialAction:"keep"`, pending-switch warning; Pi down past grace -> warn, unchanged; credential-write throw -> warn, no throw; `onlyIfFollowing` + pinned -> untouched; `managed=false` -> no-op. (describe `:568`): pinned=default suppressed; tray rotates -> falls back.
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/workspace-retirement.test.ts`: retire->pin = pinned; pin->retire = Following + `accountReleased:true`.
- Store (fixture ctx): default pins; `pinClaudeAccountToDefault:false` does not; returned row carries slug. `packages/host-service/test/ensure-main-workspace.test.ts`: pin on insert, none on existing-row branch (`ensure-main-workspace.ts:133`). `workspace-activity.test.ts:53`, `workspace-tags.test.ts:55`, `notifications.test.ts:146` pass bare `{db,eventBus}` (already missing `claudeAccounts`, accepted type debt); runtime unchanged because mint throws before pin. New adopt test: explicit adopt inserts Following.
- Renderer: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/cleanupDecisions.test.ts` for `shouldPinAfterSettle` (clear/active, abandon+confirmed+released, unreachable never, absence never, bucket not active never). Kanban uncomplete route test: pin fn invoked.

## FEATURES.md / AGENTS.md / CONTEXT.md
New row + markers (`FEATURES.md:128` block, tab-separated, `scripts/check-feature-markers.mjs:45` greps literal token under root): `(CLAUDE-ACCOUNT-PIN-ON-ACTIVATE)` at `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts`, `packages/host-service/src/workspaces`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/hooks/useDashboardSidebarState`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/components/WorkspaceExitCleanupReconciler`. Row 121 `(WORKTREE-EXIT-CLEANUP)`: replace "returns Following, and re-pinning is a manual choice ... signed off" with "returns pinned to the machine default at the moment of return (or when its pending cleanup settles)". `AGENTS.md:127-128` and `CONTEXT.md:37` "Card exit": same replacement.

## Risks / cost
- Every workspace now pinned -> keep-fresh renews each via `refreshPinned` (`index.ts:965`) -> `fetchPiToken` (`:1313`); `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/pi-client.ts:181` dedupes in-flight per slug, so N workspaces = 1 Pi call per slug per burst + N credential writes. Following workspaces cost no Pi calls today. Accepted.
- Bulk unarchive/unsnooze-all: N concurrent pins; `fetchAccounts` (`pi-client.ts:172`) and `fetchToken` dedupe in flight, so roster read is ~1 per batch. No batch code. Accepted.
- Owner offline at restore -> warn, Following; no retry.
- Settle-pin after a manual pin that a late retire cleared: re-pins to default, not the manual choice. Accepted edge.
- Helper never throws; a warn is the only signal.

## Out of scope
Fallback policy, UI, schema, retry of failed restore pins, fixing bare-ctx test type debt.

## Changes from v1
- Opt-in flag -> pin-by-default with `pinClaudeAccountToDefault:false` at adopt.ts:81 and workspaces.ts:910 only.
- Pin moved AFTER `created` broadcast; row re-read before return.
- Uncomplete in scope via standalone fn param; kanban caller (`useKanbanData.ts:500`) covered.
- Settle-pin narrowed: `onlyIfFollowing`, abandon only with `stampAfter===null && verdict==="confirmed" && ownerReleasedAccount`; `retireWorkspaceRuntime` returns `ownerReleasedAccount`.
- Restore with no default + stale pin -> forced Following.
- Sandbox workspaces hard-skipped on `cache.isSandboxHost` (approved).
- "CAS" wording removed; lock is the only ordering guard.
- Helper wraps `applyWorkspaceAccountTransition` throws; credential-write test added.
- Pi-grace third outcome (pinned + `keep` + queued) named and tested.
- Renderer callback deps fixed to include `hostWorkspaces`/`hostWorkspacesCache`.
- Bulk fan-out and keep-fresh cost stated with pi-client dedupe evidence.
- Marker roots enumerated (5); FEATURES row 121, AGENTS.md:127, CONTEXT.md:37 edits named.
- Corrected stale line refs (`workspaces.ts:541`, `useDashboardSidebarState.ts:537/1515/1525/1561/1671/1711`).

# Plan v2: pin workspace to machine default on activation

## Requirements (user-approved)
Every NEW workspace row and every un-exit (restore, unarchive, unsnooze manual+timed, uncomplete incl. kanban) pins to the tray default at that moment via a normal pin. Only the explicit adopt procedure stays Following. No default known -> Following (forcing Following if a stale pin exists) + warn. Never fail create/restore. No UI, no schema. Unmanaged hosts and cloud-sandbox workspaces: no-op.

## Recommended approach
Pin-by-default inside `insertLocalWorkspace`, opt-OUT only for explicit adopt. Smaller than v1's opt-in: one `false` at two call sites instead of `true` at six (`registerLocalWorkspace` `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspaces/workspaces.ts:541`, `workspace-creation/procedures/create-session.ts:146`, `project/utils/ensure-main-workspace.ts:138`, `workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts:109,183` reached from `workspaces.ts:758/:1032/:1097`). Safer: a future create path cannot forget the flag. Host helper `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id, {onlyIfFollowing?})` never throws; delegates to `setWorkspaceAccount` (`packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/index.ts:368`). Restore paths call a new tRPC procedure from the renderer (exit state lives only in `v2WorkspaceLocalState`).

Rejected: pin in `mintProfileForNewWorkspace` (`index.ts:312`, adopt calls it); pin in `ensureProfileForLaunch` (every launch); host-side restore detection (no exit state on host).

## Files
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/index.ts`: interface `:89` + impl. `if (!this.managed) return`. `identity = await profiles.readGlobalIdentity()` (catch -> warn). Read row slug. Cases: (a) `identity.kind==="tray"`: if `onlyIfFollowing && row.slug!==null` skip; else `setWorkspaceAccount(id, identity.slug)`. (b) not tray: if `row.slug!==null && !onlyIfFollowing` -> `setWorkspaceAccount(id, null)` (force Following); else warn "no machine default". Whole body in try/catch -> `log.warn` with `{workspaceId, slug, error}`; `applyWorkspaceAccountTransition` (`:1585`) can throw mid credential write / DB update, so the catch must wrap the transition too. Call OUTSIDE locks: `setWorkspaceAccount` takes `withWorkspaceLock` (`:377`). Marker comment here.
- `packages/host-service/src/workspaces/local-workspace-store.ts`: `InsertWorkspaceStoreContext.claudeAccounts` (`:52`) gains the helper; `InsertLocalWorkspaceValues` (`:237`) gains `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` (default true). In `insertLocalWorkspace` AFTER `emitWorkspaceChanged` + `trackWorkspaceEvent` (`:304-305`): `if (values.pinClaudeAccountToDefault !== false) await ctx.claudeAccounts.pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id)`; then `getLocalWorkspace` re-read (`:296` pattern) and return that row. Broadcast is not delayed by Pi timeouts; the mutation return is (bounded by Pi client timeouts). Marker comment here.
- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts`: new arg `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` forwarded to both inserts (`:109`, `:183`). `workspace-creation/procedures/adopt.ts:81` and `workspaces.ts:910` (the `input.worktreePath` branch, `:893`) pass `false`. All other callers unchanged -> pin.
- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/claude-accounts/claude-accounts.ts`: `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: protectedProcedure.input(workspaceInput.extend({onlyIfFollowing: z.boolean().optional()})).mutation(...)`, no PRECONDITION wrap (helper cannot throw).
- `packages/host-service/test/helpers/claude-accounts-fixture.ts:53`: add fake `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: async () => {}`.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/hooks/host-service/useClaudeAccounts/useClaudeAccounts.ts`: plain async `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(hostUrl, workspaceId, opts)` via `getHostServiceClientByUrl` (`:93`); on success invalidate account-state caches (`:98`).
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/retireWorkspaceRuntime.ts:37`: return `{verdict, ownerReleasedAccount}` where `ownerReleasedAccount = owner reply kind==="answered" && outcome.foundWorkspace && outcome.accountReleased`. Update `useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:198,216` destructuring.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/cleanupDecisions.ts`: pure `shouldPinAfterSettle({outcome, stampAfter, verdict, ownerReleasedAccount, bucket})` -> true iff `bucket==="active"` AND (`outcome==="clear"` OR (`outcome==="abandon" && stampAfter===null && verdict==="confirmed" && ownerReleasedAccount`)). Never on `unreachable`, never on absence (absence gives `ownerReleasedAccount=false`).
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/components/WorkspaceExitCleanupReconciler/useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:217-225`: after outcome, if `shouldPinAfterSettle` -> pin to `target.ownerHostUrl` with `onlyIfFollowing:true`, skipping when `target.isSandbox` (`:114`). Bucket via `getWorkspaceSidebarBucket` (`apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/providers/CollectionsProvider/dashboardSidebarLocal/sidebarVisibility.ts:178`). `onlyIfFollowing` is what protects a manual pin made after restore. Marker comment here.
- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/hooks/useDashboardSidebarState/useDashboardSidebarState.ts`: standalone `uncompleteWorkspaceInSidebar` (`:537`) gains a required `pinTarget: {workspaces, cache}` param and fires the pin after the update; both callers (`:1711`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/kanban/hooks/useKanbanData/useKanbanData.ts:500`, which already calls `useHostWorkspaces` at `:144` and must also destructure `cache`) pass it. `unsnoozeWorkspace` (`:1525`), `unarchiveWorkspaces` (`:1561`), `restoreWorkspace` (`:1671`), `autoReturnSnoozedWorkspace` (`:1515`): after the update, if `runtimeCleanupPendingAt` is null -> fire pin; else do nothing (auto-return keeps debt, `sidebarMutations.ts:126`; reconciler pins on settle: accepted deviation from "at that moment"). Deps of these callbacks are `[collections]` today; add `hostWorkspaces, hostWorkspacesCache` (`:552-553`). Owner URL: `hostWorkspaces` row `hostId` -> `cache.resolveHostUrl`; hard skip when `cache.isSandboxHost(hostId)` (approved; no VM wake). Marker comment here.

## Sequence
Create: insert -> mint (Following creds) -> `created` broadcast -> pin (lock: roster/grace/token -> creds write + unconditional DB set `index.ts:477`, cause manual) -> re-read -> return.
Restore: renderer clears flags/cancels stamp -> pin RPC to owner -> same path. Retire and pin serialize on `withWorkspaceLock` (`:507`); ordering safety comes ONLY from the lock (DB write is `{kind:"set"}`, `:1600`, not compare-and-set). Pin-then-late-retire (owner reports `accountReleased:true`) is repaired by the settle-pin.
Pi grace (`:382-439`): three outcomes: pinned+token; pinned with `credentialAction:"keep"` and switch queued until Pi recovers (existing manual-pin semantics, `refreshPinned :965` finishes it); throw past grace -> warn, Following.

## Build order
1. Host helper + interface + fixture; unit tests. 2. Store default-pin + adopt opt-out (2 sites) + re-read; store/ensure-main tests. 3. Router procedure. 4. `retireWorkspaceRuntime` return shape + `shouldPinAfterSettle` + reconciler. 5. Renderer pin fn + un-exit callbacks + uncomplete param (both callers). 6. FEATURES.md / AGENTS.md / CONTEXT.md.

## Tests
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/service-regressions.test.ts` (describe `:191`): tray -> slug=default, `cause:"manual"`; absent identity + Following -> null + warn; absent identity + stale pin -> `setWorkspaceAccount(id,null)` called, row Following; Pi down within grace with last-good roster -> pinned, `credentialAction:"keep"`, pending-switch warning; Pi down past grace -> warn, unchanged; credential-write throw -> warn, no throw; `onlyIfFollowing` + pinned -> untouched; `managed=false` -> no-op. (describe `:568`): pinned=default suppressed; tray rotates -> falls back.
- `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/workspace-retirement.test.ts`: retire->pin = pinned; pin->retire = Following + `accountReleased:true`.
- Store (fixture ctx): default pins; `pinClaudeAccountToDefault:false` does not; returned row carries slug. `packages/host-service/test/ensure-main-workspace.test.ts`: pin on insert, none on existing-row branch (`ensure-main-workspace.ts:133`). `workspace-activity.test.ts:53`, `workspace-tags.test.ts:55`, `notifications.test.ts:146` pass bare `{db,eventBus}` (already missing `claudeAccounts`, accepted type debt); runtime unchanged because mint throws before pin. New adopt test: explicit adopt inserts Following.
- Renderer: `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/cleanupDecisions.test.ts` for `shouldPinAfterSettle` (clear/active, abandon+confirmed+released, unreachable never, absence never, bucket not active never). Kanban uncomplete route test: pin fn invoked.

## FEATURES.md / AGENTS.md / CONTEXT.md
New row + markers (`FEATURES.md:128` block, tab-separated, `scripts/check-feature-markers.mjs:45` greps literal token under root): `(CLAUDE-ACCOUNT-PIN-ON-ACTIVATE)` at `packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts`, `packages/host-service/src/workspaces`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/hooks/useDashboardSidebarState`, `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/components/WorkspaceExitCleanupReconciler`. Row 121 `(WORKTREE-EXIT-CLEANUP)`: replace "returns Following, and re-pinning is a manual choice ... signed off" with "returns pinned to the machine default at the moment of return (or when its pending cleanup settles)". `AGENTS.md:127-128` and `CONTEXT.md:37` "Card exit": same replacement.

## Risks / cost
- Every workspace now pinned -> keep-fresh renews each via `refreshPinned` (`index.ts:965`) -> `fetchPiToken` (`:1313`); `pi-client.ts:181` dedupes in-flight per slug, so N workspaces = 1 Pi call per slug per burst + N credential writes. Accepted.
- Bulk unarchive/unsnooze-all: N concurrent pins; `fetchAccounts` (`pi-client.ts:172`) and `fetchToken` dedupe in flight. No batch code. Accepted.
- Owner offline at restore -> warn, Following; no retry.
- Settle-pin after a manual pin that a late retire cleared: re-pins to default, not the manual choice. Accepted edge.
- Helper never throws; a warn is the only signal.

## Out of scope
Fallback policy, UI, schema, retry of failed restore pins, fixing bare-ctx test type debt, cloud-sandbox removal (separate task).

Create: insert row (slug null) -> mint profile (Following creds) -> pin -> `setWorkspaceAccount` under lock: roster/grace/token -> DB set + creds write -> `created` broadcast.
Restore: renderer clears flags + cancels stamp -> pin RPC to owner host -> same path. Retirement and pin both serialize on `withWorkspaceLock` (`index.ts:507`), so a pin arriving during a retirement waits and wins; pin-then-late-retire is repaired by the reconciler's abandon branch.

## Fallback interaction (stated consequence)
`runFallbacks` skips a pin equal to the tray default (`index.ts:1154`) and `commitFallback` discards it too (:1240). So an activation-pinned workspace on default A never falls back while the tray still says A, even if A crosses a trigger line: identical to Following today, no regression. When the tray rotates to B, the next tick evaluates A against triggers; every such workspace falls back to Following (= B) permanently IF A has crossed a trigger, otherwise stays pinned to A. Existing semantics; nothing to change.

(describe :568): activation-pinned = default -> suppressed; tray rotates -> falls back.

## Risks / edge cases
- Pin doubles Pi token fetches per creation (mint Following creds, then pinned token). Acceptable; avoids new transition code.
- Owner offline at restore -> pin RPC fails -> warn, Following. No retry (stamp mechanism is exit-only; spec forbids new flags).
- `getWorkspaceSidebarBucket` "hidden" (sidebar-removed main) is not active -> not pinned; matches spec.

HOST helper `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(workspaceId, {onlyIfFollowing?: boolean})` in `claude-accounts/index.ts`:
- A1. The WHOLE body runs inside `withWorkspaceLock(workspaceId)`: identity read + row read + transition. Refactor `setWorkspaceAccount` into a thin lock wrapper + an inner `setWorkspaceAccountLocked(...)` (same logic, no lock) so the helper can call the inner one under the lock it already holds. Manual `setWorkspaceAccount` behaviour unchanged.
- A2. Identity read THROWS -> warn, no-op (never touch the row). Mirror `readGlobalIdentityOrWarn` (`index.ts:1492`).
- A3. Decision table (row = current slug under lock):
  - tray + (onlyIfFollowing && row pinned) -> skip silently.
  - tray otherwise -> try inner pin(identity.slug). On throw (dead/missing slug, Pi past grace, transition failure) -> warn; then if (!onlyIfFollowing && row pinned) -> FORCE Following via a Pi-independent clear (same mechanism retirement uses at `index.ts:~537`: clear slug + credentials to Following/last-good, no roster validation). Never throw.
  - absent / unmanaged -> warn "no machine default"; if (!onlyIfFollowing && row pinned) -> FORCE Following, Pi-independent, as above.
- A4. Helper never throws; returns void.
- A5. Row missing -> warn, return.

STORE / callers:
- A6. Only ONE opt-out site: `workspace-creation/procedures/adopt.ts:81` passes `pinClaudeAccountToDefault:false` through `adoptExistingWorktree`. `workspaces.ts:910` (`worktreePath` branch of `workspaces.create`) is NOT opted out (it is a create; no caller passes worktreePath today). `workspaces.ts:758` create-from-PR pins (it is a create).
- A7. Keep pin AFTER `emitWorkspaceChanged`; convergence for the renderer comes from the `claude-account-state-changed` event the transition already emits (`index.ts:~1652`), plus the re-read return.
- A8. `workspace-tags.test.ts` / `workspace-activity.test.ts` bare-ctx tests are ALREADY RED on main (TypeError at `local-workspace-store.ts:299`). Do not "fix" them as part of this; do not count them as coverage. Add new store coverage using the fixture ctx.

RENDERER:
- A9. `retireWorkspaceRuntime` returns `{verdict, settledAtUrl: string|null, ownerReleasedAccount: boolean}`; `ownerReleasedAccount` = ANY answered reply with `foundWorkspace && accountReleased` (non-owners answer false, `index.ts:516`); `settledAtUrl` = URL of the reply that claimed the workspace (null on absence-proven clear). Keep the `verdicts` map typed as `Map<string, RetirementVerdict>` (destructure at `useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:~198`).
- A10. Settle-pin goes to `settledAtUrl` (not `target.ownerHostUrl`); skip when null. Wrap the pin call in try/catch + `console.warn` so a rejection never breaks the `Promise.all` sweep / `showCleanupToast`.
- A11. Un-exit callbacks keep deps `[collections]`; read `hostWorkspaces` / `cache` via refs (avoid re-running `useDashboardSidebarData.ts:479` effect on every host-list change).
- A12. Before sending a restore/un-exit pin, the renderer checks the row is still in the "active" bucket (rejects stale activation work).
- A13. Comment in `shouldPinAfterSettle`: `outcome==="clear"` reaches here only via auto-return (`sidebarMutations.ts:126` keeps the stamp).

TESTS (additional): restore -> immediate re-exit ordering (pin must not land on a retired row when the lock serialises them); manual switch in flight vs settle-pin with onlyIfFollowing (manual wins); tray slug dead/missing at activation with stale pin -> Following; identity read throw -> row untouched.

tRPC CONTRACT (fixed, both sides build against it):
`claudeAccounts.pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault` mutation, input `{ workspaceId: string (uuid), onlyIfFollowing?: boolean }`, output `void`. Never throws for account reasons; may throw for unknown workspace id only.
EOF

1	# Plan v2: pin workspace to machine default on activation
2	
3	## Requirements (user-approved)
4	Every NEW workspace row and every un-exit (restore, unarchive, unsnooze manual+timed, uncomplete incl. kanban) pins to the tray default at that moment via a normal pin. Only the explicit adopt procedure stays Following. No default known -> Following (forcing Following if a stale pin exists) + warn. Never fail create/restore. No UI, no schema. Unmanaged hosts and cloud-sandbox workspaces: no-op.
5	
6	## Recommended approach
7	Pin-by-default inside `insertLocalWorkspace`, opt-OUT only for explicit adopt. Smaller than v1's opt-in: one `false` at two call sites instead of `true` at six (`registerLocalWorkspace` `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspaces/workspaces.ts:541`, `workspace-creation/procedures/create-session.ts:146`, `project/utils/ensure-main-workspace.ts:138`, `workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts:109,183` reached from `workspaces.ts:758/:1032/:1097`). Host helper `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id, {onlyIfFollowing?})` never throws; delegates to `setWorkspaceAccount` (`packages/host-service/src/claude-accounts/index.ts:368`). Call OUTSIDE locks: `setWorkspaceAccount` takes `withWorkspaceLock` (`:377`). Marker comment here.
13	- `packages/host-service/src/workspaces/local-workspace-store.ts`: `InsertWorkspaceStoreContext.claudeAccounts` (`:52`) gains the helper; `InsertLocalWorkspaceValues` (`:237`) gains `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` (default true). In `insertLocalWorkspace` AFTER `emitWorkspaceChanged` + `trackWorkspaceEvent` (`:304-305`): `if (values.pinClaudeAccountToDefault !== false) await ctx.claudeAccounts.pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(id)`; then `getLocalWorkspace` re-read (`:296` pattern) and return that row. Broadcast is not delayed by Pi timeouts; the mutation return is (bounded by Pi client timeouts). Marker comment here.
14	- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/workspace-creation/shared/adopt-existing-worktree.ts`: new arg `pinClaudeAccountToDefault?: boolean` forwarded to both inserts (`:109`, `:183`). `workspace-creation/procedures/adopt.ts:81` and `workspaces.ts:910` (the `input.worktreePath` branch, `:893`) pass `false`. 15	- `packages/host-service/src/trpc/router/claude-accounts/claude-accounts.ts`: `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: protectedProcedure.input(workspaceInput.extend({onlyIfFollowing: z.boolean().optional()})).mutation(...)`, no PRECONDITION wrap (helper cannot throw).
16	- `packages/host-service/test/helpers/claude-accounts-fixture.ts:53`: add fake `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault: async () => {}`.
17	- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/hooks/host-service/useClaudeAccounts/useClaudeAccounts.ts`: plain async `pinWorkspaceToMachineDefault(hostUrl, workspaceId, opts)` via `getHostServiceClientByUrl` (`:93`); on success invalidate account-state caches (`:98`).
18	- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/retireWorkspaceRuntime.ts:37`: return `{verdict, ownerReleasedAccount}` where `ownerReleasedAccount = owner reply kind==="answered" && outcome.foundWorkspace && outcome.accountReleased`. 19	- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/lib/workspace-exit-cleanup/cleanupDecisions.ts`: pure `shouldPinAfterSettle({outcome, stampAfter, verdict, ownerReleasedAccount, bucket})` -> true iff `bucket==="active"` AND (`outcome==="clear"` OR (`outcome==="abandon" && stampAfter===null && verdict==="confirmed" && ownerReleasedAccount`)). 20	- `apps/desktop/src/renderer/routes/_authenticated/_dashboard/components/WorkspaceExitCleanupReconciler/useWorkspaceExitCleanup.ts:217-225`: after outcome, if `shouldPinAfterSettle` -> pin to `target.ownerHostUrl` with `onlyIfFollowing:true`, skipping when `target.isSandbox` (`:114`). content.text:
`/simplify → 4 cleanup agents in parallel → apply the fixes`

You are improving the quality of the changed code, not hunting for bugs. Review
it for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then fix what you
find. Do not look for correctness bugs — that is what `/code-review` is for.

## Phase 0 — Gather the diff

Run `git diff @{upstream}...HEAD` (or `git diff main...HEAD` / `git diff HEAD~1`
if there's no upstream) to get the unified diff under review. If there are
uncommitted changes, or the range diff is empty, also run `git diff HEAD` and
include the working-tree changes in scope — the review often runs before the
commit. If a PR number, branch name, or file path was passed as an argument,
review that target instead. Treat this diff as the review scope.

## Phase 1 — Review (4 cleanup agents in parallel)

Launch **4 independent review agents** via the Agent tool, all in a
single message so they run concurrently. Pass each agent the diff and one of
the four angles below. Each returns its findings with `file`, `line`, a
one-line `summary`, and the concrete cost (what is duplicated, wasted, or
harder to maintain).

### Reuse

Flag new code that re-implements something the codebase
already has — Grep shared/utility modules and files adjacent to the change,
and name the existing helper to call instead.

### Simplification

Flag unnecessary complexity the diff adds: redundant or derivable state,
copy-paste with slight variation, deep nesting, dead code left behind. Name
the simpler form that does the same job.

### Efficiency

Flag wasted work the diff introduces: redundant computation or repeated I/O,
independent operations run sequentially, blocking work added to startup or
hot paths. Also flag long-lived objects built from closures or captured
environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's
lifetime (a memory leak when that scope holds large values); prefer a
class/struct that copies only the fields it needs. Name the cheaper
alternative.

### Altitude

Check that each change fixes the root cause at the right depth rather than
patching a symptom with a fragile bandaid. Special cases layered on shared
infrastructure are a sign the fix isn't deep enough — prefer the simpler, more
general change to the underlying mechanism over adding special cases, and name
that change.

## Phase 2 — Apply the fixes

Wait for all four agents to complete, dedup findings that point at the same
line or mechanism, and fix each remaining one directly. Skip any finding whose
fix would change intended behavior, require changes well outside the reviewed
diff, or that you judge to be a false positive — note the skip rather than
arguing with it. Finish with a brief summary of what was fixed and what was
skipped (or confirm the code was already clean).
